status: experiment - not wired into the game
keeper_scale: pixel-identical to keeper_walk_south_0001 (same NN x0.5 of the native 170x256 frame); in a 192 canvas the 128 walk frame sits at x+32
pulse_sync: walk timing (9 x 100 ms = 900 ms). The tool harvest pulse is 1000 ms: either restart the clip on each pulse 500 ms early (frame 9 then holds ~100 ms longer), or play at speed_scale 0.9 so one loop = 1000 ms.
palette: every visible pixel RGB is a colour that occurs in keeper_walk_south_0001..0009
